aboutus.p1: GMH Engineering Solutions provides multidisciplinary engineering, consulting and project management services supporting industrial, infrastructure and energy projects across Europe and Africa.
aboutus.chairmandesc1: At GMH, our vision centers on continuous excellence, aiming to be your professional, passionate, and nimble partner in realizing strategic business and sustainability goals. Our mission is rooted in the expertise of our devoted team, offering comprehensive solutions for industrial plants, infrastructures, and buildings, ranging from singular projects to extensive business process outsourcing solutions.
aboutus.chairmandesc2: With over 25 years of experience in Multidiscipline Engineering and Operation Management overseeing 35+ industrial projects, I bring a customer-oriented approach and strong technical knowledge to ensure our commitment to excellence and effective interfaces management. Explore GMH Engineering Solutions, where innovation and client satisfaction converge for a future of unparalleled success.
aboutus.chairmandesc3: Our multidisciplinary teams continue to support industries across Europe and Africa by transforming complex engineering challenges into successful project outcomes.
aboutus.visiondesc1: Our vision is to become a trusted international engineering partner recognised for technical excellence, sustainable   innovation and long-term client relationships. We strive to help industries successfully navigate increasingly complex engineering   challenges while contributing to a safer and more sustainable future.
aboutus.visiondesc2: We aspire to continually enhance our expertise, nurturing our reputation as a professional, passionate, and nimble partner. Through these qualities, we dedicate ourselves to assisting our clients in the realization of their strategic business and sustainability objectives.

consultingservices.title: Consulting and HR Support
consultingservices.subtitle: At GMH Engineering Solutions, we provide tailored Consulting & HR Support services that connect businesses with the right engineering talent for every project. Whether you need flexible staffing, specialized expertise, or additional project resources, our experienced professionals are ready to support brownfield and greenfield projects worldwide.
consultingservices.recruitment: Recruitment Solutions Tailored to Your Needs
consultingservices.recruitmentdesc1: We provide end-to-end recruitment solutions, from understanding your staffing needs to sourcing, evaluating, and presenting highly qualified candidates. Our team manages screening, interviews, reference checks, administrative verification, and offers expert guidance throughout the hiring process to ensure the right talent for your business.
consultingservices.recruitmentdesc2: Whether you are in need of flexible staffing solutions, specialized non-core competence experts, or facing resource availability challenges, GMH stands as the definitive answer. Our extensive roster of experts, spanning from feed engineering to on-site support services, caters to both brownfield and greenfield projects across the globe.
consultingservices.documentationdesc1: We provide end-to-end recruitment solutions, from understanding your staffing needs to sourcing, evaluating, and presenting highly qualified candidates. Our team manages screening, interviews, reference checks, administrative verification, and offers expert guidance throughout the hiring process to ensure the right talent for your business.
consultingservices.teamdesc: We provide technical assistance by augmenting your existing team with GMH technicians, designers, engineers, and multidisciplinary engineering experts. Our flexibility knows no bounds, allowing us to work seamlessly at your premises, GMH facilities, or a hybrid combination of both. You can count on our project managers and experts to be where you need them, while our designers work from GMH premises, ensuring optimal project coordination and execution
